assessment: A strong, well-structured response with correct financial math throughout: the $6,000 surplus, $40 contribution per order, loaded costs ($5,800 employee / $4,500 agency), and break-even orders (145/113) are all accurate without CAC double-counting. The employee recommendation is defensible and tied to the capacity gap, backed by a phased 90-day plan with measurable checkpoints. Main weaknesses are unbudgeted founder management hours, day-90 thresholds not derived from cash obligations, a CAC-only continuation trigger, and unaddressed severance/turnover exposure and the 6-week pre-hire gap.
judge_agreement: All five judges agreed the core financial calculations are correct and free of rule errors, and that the recommendation is defensible. Four judges clustered tightly (7-9) across criteria, consistently flagging the same gaps: founder time budgeting, threshold derivation, and employee termination costs. The Google judge was a consistent positive outlier, awarding perfect 10s and 'None needed' improvements, while the Anthropic judge was slightly harsher on risk (7) due to attribution and hire-reversal concerns.
